correctness.rationale: The claim is finite.  The six-point construction is directly checked against the defining conditions. value.rationale: Complete bipartite graphs are singled out in the introducing paper through a natural coloring construction.  \(K_{3,4}\) is a minimum-order nontrivial complete-bipartite instance where that published bound is provably not sharp: the exact value is \(6\) rather than \(7\), while every smaller \(K_{a,b}\) with \(2\le a\le b\) meets the bound.  This gives a concrete boundary case and a compact exact benchmark for attempts to determine \(t(K_{a,b})\) more generally.
